summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the transformer, switchgear, power-quality, and power-distribution-equipment node. The cleanest underfollowed exposure is Hammond Power Solutions via OTC/TSX because it directly manufactures dry-type transformers, power-quality products, and magnetics. Powell Industries is a direct US-listed switchgear and electrical-equipment beneficiary with explicit data-center and utility backlog evidence, but its market cap has moved above the preferred USD 300M-10B hunting band. Preformed Line Products is a less obvious second-order grid/transmission hardware supplier rather than a transformer company, included because transmission hardware procurement can precede line construction and may benefit from grid buildout. Hubbell is included as a diversified reference leader, not the primary discovery target.
